name: Shader Starter Pack
author: the ReShade shader community
description:
Six open shader packs for ReShade, by their makers.
1. Pick a tab, then press Install Shaders.
2. Games below with a ReShade preset: press Preset to see the effects it needs, and install the missing packs.
Every pack here has an open license: MIT, GPL-2.0 or GPL-3.0.
license: Open licenses only: MIT, GPL-2.0 and GPL-3.0

options.label: Look
options.author: CeeJay.dk and prod80
options.description:
For any game ReShade runs in.
It installs 2 shader packs:
1. SweetFX by CeeJay.dk (MIT): sharpening, colors, vignette and more.
2. prod80 (MIT): color grading, curves and film looks.
Then, in ReShade (Home key):
1. Tick an effect, like LumaSharpen.
2. Change its settings under the list.
Games below with a ReShade preset: press Preset to see the effects it needs, and install the missing packs.

options.label: Light
options.author: AlucardDH and vortigern11
options.description:
Needs the game's depth. GPU Selector loads a depth add-on for you.
It installs 2 shader packs:
1. DH shaders by AlucardDH (GPL-2.0): DH_UBER_RT ray traced light, shadows and reflections, plus anime looks.
2. vort_Shaders by vortigern11 (MIT): bloom, sharpening, color grading and motion blur.
Then, in ReShade (Home key):
1. Tick an effect, like DH_UBER_RT.
2. Change its settings under the list.
vort's maker suggests the REST add-on, to keep effects off the game's menus.
Games below with a ReShade preset: press Preset to see the effects it needs, and install the missing packs.

options.label: HDR
options.author: Lilium
options.description:
Needs an HDR display, with HDR on in Windows.
It installs 1 shader pack:
1. Lilium's HDR shaders (GPL-3.0): HDR analysis, HDR fixes, and SDR to HDR.
Then, in ReShade (Home key):
1. Tick an effect, like HDR analysis.
2. Change its settings under the list.
Games below with a ReShade preset: press Preset to see the effects it needs, and install the missing packs.

options.label: Retro

options.description:
For any game ReShade runs in.

Then, in ReShade (Home key):
